session_summary: Completed Gloomwood Hollow route, gathered starting coins, and successfully purchased the Trail Cap cosmetic from the marketplace. Monitored collection progression and route variety based on the explorer persona focus.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow without in-game UI tracking for unique collectibles (Gloomcap, Root Relic) shown in the world state.
observations.recommendation: Implement the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to give collectors a visible checklist of items gathered per route.

observations.evidence: Purchased 'trail_cap' for 45 coins leaving 88 coins balance after route completion.
observations.recommendation: Expand cosmetic categorization or add preview modes for hat and trail types to enhance the collecting metagame.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
feature_requests.player_value: Gives explorers and collectors clear visibility over uncollected items, unique route lore, and completion milestones.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, players have no in-game ledger tracking which collectibles (like Gloomcaps or Root Relics) they have found across different routes.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game collection journal menu tracking route discovery milestones and cosmetic checklists.

keep: Rewarding completion payouts that allow quick early-game cosmetic purchases like the Trail Cap
Diverse thematic route catalog ranging from Gloomwood Hollow to Ember Forge
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
